atmospheric: A low wind moves through the ruins like a sentence trying to finish itself.
The light is older than the hour. This place keeps its own clock.
Somewhere, a stone settles. The settling sounds deliberate.
The air carries the faint metal of the charge and the older taste of mud.
Shadows lean further than the things that cast them.
A bird, or something that learned to sound like one, calls once and does not call again.
The silence here is not empty. It is held.
Footprints from no recent traveller cross the path ahead, leading neither in nor out.
Dust drifts upward at the edges of the room, as if mistaking the ceiling for the floor.
There is a smell of cold paper, though no books remain.
The horizon shimmers, settles, shimmers again.
A single shaft of sun finds the floor through a crack centuries old.
aether: The charge tightens. Skin notices before the mind does.
Violet threads briefly knit the air, then forget the pattern.
The bedrock hums beneath the boots, just below the threshold of hearing.
A small static lifts the hairs on the arm. Then a smaller one.
Light bends slightly around nothing in particular.
The charge moves the way deep water moves: invisibly, then all at once.
Motes gather thick near the standing stones. Breath comes thicker with them.
A taste of copper. A taste of ozone. A taste of something not in the body's vocabulary.
Compass needles drift, settle on a north of their own choosing.
Time slips by half a heartbeat, then catches up apologetically.
A faint glow lives inside the mud here, like a banked coal.
The charge listens. Whether it understands is a separate question.
Somewhere underfoot, a deep engine or its echo keeps a slow rhythm.
ruins: Stone here remembers being shaped. The shape has weathered. The memory has not.
A doorway leans without a wall to lean against.
Runes run along the lintel, half-buried in mud, still legible to the patient eye.
Old builders raised this. The proportions argue for them more than the records do.
A staircase ends in mud, or begins from it, depending on the direction one is travelling.
Frescoes survive in patches. Faces look out from the patches without judgment.
A broken conduit lies across the floor, its purpose still humming softly.
The walls have not stopped being walls. They have only stopped being inside something.
Pillars stand at angles the architects did not intend. The mud has its own opinions.
A fountain remains, dry, its basin holding a fine grit of centuries.
The floor here is tiled in a pattern that resolves only from above.
Something was inscribed here in haste, after the flood arrived. It does not improve with reading.
danger: Something has been here recently. Recently, here, can mean many things.
The mud holds a print too large for a single footprint and too regular for an accident.
A trap is set, somewhere within a few careful paces.
An anomaly tightens the air to a held note.
The buried city above stirs, or below, depending on how one orients.
A heavy footstep, or its memory, lands in the next chamber.
Something has sung here within the last day. The air still carries the shape.
Sleepers lie nearby, in their rest. Whether they remain in it is currently undecided.
The dust moves against the draft. Something else is moving the air.
Eyes meet at the edge of the lamplight, briefly, and then move on. Briefly is the word to mark.
Some heavy thing's posture sets these acoustics. The room is wrong in that specific way.
Old defenses still know their job. Newer arrivals are less informed.
mystery: Something here was meant to be found. By someone. Not necessarily by you.
A symbol repeats along the wall, growing fainter, then bolder, then absent.
A door without hinges. A hinge without a door. Decide which is the question.
The old scholars would have spent a season on this passage. There is not a season to spend.
Names have been carved into the stone, all in the same hand, all from different centuries.
The bedrock shifts colour near truth. The colour is shifting now.
Whatever happened here is still happening, very slowly.
A relic waits without obviously waiting.
The runes form a question. The question forms a deeper one.
This place left no manuals. Only invitations. This is one of them.
Someone arranged these objects. The arrangement is not accidental, and it is not finished.
There is a pattern in the dust on the floor. It rewards the kind of attention that does not blink.
